title: Lift the live-work sync engine out of the 715-line surface into a tested client
deviations_from_card: Write set SHRUNK: liveWorkDraft.test.ts and devcase-candidate-refusals.test.ts left untouched - their source pins (persistDraft writes chat/name/contact; component uses useErrorMessage, never body.error ?? t(...)) still hold on the rewired component, so moving them would only weaken them. Acceptance grew 8 -> 9: added 'a thrown mint stays retryable next tick' (suspension is not a refusal). Case 3 additionally pins that a 403-blocked session issues no further flush requests (the same infinite-retry loop as the mint, on the flush door). Backoff = 60s doubling per repeat refusal, capped 15 min; explicit clicks (submit, chat send) cross it once via ensureSession({explicit:true}); retryMint() exists on the client but no UI button was added (would need catalog keys). Also fixed in passing: a flush no longer clears filesDirty when the tree was edited while the request was on the wire. Component 715 -> 517 lines; no route, catalog or wire change; no internal id added to the wire.
notes: Full test:unit exit 1 and test:perf exit 1 are sibling in-flight work only: BROKEN files are analyze-github-stage, job-workspace-state(+tenancy), python-runner-concurrency, decisionsWaveKeepKind, about/scenes/beats; perf overages are app/page.tsx, llm-config.ts, job-ingest.ts (pre-existing), devcase/lifecycle/approve route and status/letter route (server graphs, not importing the apply surface). All devcase tests (62 across app/devcase/apply/* and app/api/devcase/*) pass. Whole-tree tsc red only on foreign paths (decisionsScreenWaveMachine/useDecisionsScreenWave, about/chapters.test.ts, untracked kpi-sim/). Doc committed alone under the lock (74ccf82eb, lands before the component commit b870e0480 in history, with 2 sibling llm-api commits interleaved).
